Khatta,_Khutta

See below Khindaka, Khutta an. Khuntu.

Khātakāviśeṣa
Jain. Apabhraṁśa. by Tāraṇ Svāmin (1448-1515 A. D.).
See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XIV. ii. p. 35; also Jain Ant. XII. ii. p. 60.

Khātara_Miśra
father of Mādhava (a. of Divyadīpikā, dh., C. 1350-1600 A. D. an. brother of Dinakara mentioned by Mādhava. Mithilā I. 208-209).
